message.darkspawn.aircraft_mounted: Aircraft: WASD steers, Jump rises, X descends, Sneak exits. Land before editing.
message.darkspawn.aircraft_assembled: Aircraft assembled and bound to you. Empty-hand use to pilot. Land and sneak-use to restore the blocks for editing.
message.darkspawn.aircraft_blocked: Use the core on a flat 3x3 airframe: center plus four arms, optional corners. Use planks, logs, wool, glass or iron blocks. Clear a 5x5 area on solid ground and stand beside it.
message.darkspawn.aircraft_edit: Airframe restored in its original orientation. Edit the blocks and use the returned core on the center.
message.darkspawn.aircraft_edit_blocked: Only the owner can edit a stopped, landed, empty aircraft. Clear the landing area and stand beside it.
